_comment: Single source of truth for the distributable Eclipse Event .mrpack (docs/BUNDLING.md, plans_v5 D9). build_mrpack.py resolves every 'modrinth' entry against the Modrinth API by exact jar filename (URL + sha1/sha512 + size come from the API), 'manual' entries land in overrides/MANUAL_INSTALL.md, and 'embedded' entries are documentation-only (they ride jarJar'd inside the Eclipse jar and must NOT be installed separately).
name: Eclipse Event
summary: Project: Eclipse community event pack — NeoForge 1.21.1. Public mods are referenced from Modrinth; the Eclipse jar and default configs ride as overrides.

mods.name: Sodium
mods.note: Client performance extra; crashes a dedicated server (LWJGL bootstrap). Nests the four Forgified-Fabric-API sub-module ids — allowlisted, no separate install.

mods.name: Iris
mods.note: Client shader extra; same nested Forgified-Fabric-API sub-modules as Sodium.

mods.name: Create: Aeronautics bundle (Aeronautics, Simulated, Offroad)
mods.note: Private bundled build; its Simulated Project License forbids rebundling and it is not treated as a stable public CDN artifact. Obtain the authorized event-pack jar from the event operator (docs/BUNDLING.md).

mods.name: Sable
mods.note: PolyForm Shield 1.0.0 — external installation from the official source is the safe policy (docs/BUNDLING.md). Obtain from the event operator.

mods.name: Veil
mods.note: jarJar-embedded inside the Eclipse jar (LGPL-3.0). Do NOT install separately.

mods.name: GeckoLib
mods.note: jarJar-embedded inside the Eclipse jar (MIT). Do NOT install separately.

mods.name: EMI
mods.note: jarJar-embedded inside the Eclipse jar (MIT). Do NOT install separately.

mods.name: Mouse Tweaks
mods.note: jarJar-embedded inside the Eclipse jar (BSD-3-Clause). Do NOT install separately.
